prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A sweeping, cinematic fantasy landscape set in a vast, rocky canyon under a muted, overcast sky. In the foreground, a group of cloaked travelers on horseback and on foot stand at the edge of a shallow river, gazing upward in awe. Dominating the scene is a dramatic, swirling, crescent-shaped formation of dark, feathered material—part bird, part shadow—suspended in midair. At its center, a mysterious, hooded figure in flowing, tattered robes sits astride the creature, exuding an aura of power and enigma. The canyon walls rise steeply on either side, their warm ochre and sandstone hues contrasting with the cool, desaturated tones of the sky and water. The lighting is soft and diffuse, casting gentle shadows and enhancing the sense of depth and scale. The composition uses a high vantage point and deep focus, drawing the viewer’s eye from the travelers below to the soaring, supernatural figure above, evoking a sense of wonder, tension, and epic adventure. The overall style is painterly and hyper-realistic, reminiscent of high-fantasy concept art or a still from an epic film.
